_comment: Sizes distillation students built from the catalog to one training and one sampling GPU with batch 1, sets the validated peak learning rate (1e-6), packs micro-batches up to one 16384-token episode, and sets ZeRO reduce_scatter and the huggingface model provider. Keep the training and sampling GPU counts equal: weight sync between a 1-GPU and a multi-GPU sub-job fails on H200. Skipped with job_config=. With job_id=, the merged job is not submitted, but the example still reads settings such as the model, batch size and learning rate from it, so keep them matching the attached job. See examples/README.md, "How an example builds its job", for how this file is merged.
